old_versions.v2_request_and_manifest: immutable; v2 is not launch-ready because runtime_v8 does not consume deferred records

deferred_native.v8_parent_behavior: runtime_v8 hashes input_files only; its deferred fields are metadata and do not protect these Part files

child.manifest_adapter: wrapper writes a temporary schema-v1 view inside attempt_root; consumed v1/v2 manifests are never edited
child.child_process_group: new session; SIGTERM then bounded SIGKILL/reap
child.parent_death: wrapper checks os.getppid during polling and terminates the child process group
child.cancellation: SIGTERM/SIGINT and runtime deadline/cancellation terminate and reap the child group

scratch.polling: bounded recursive file-size sum while child is alive plus final post-exit check
scratch.over_cap: terminate child group, mark FAILED_CHILD_CANCELLED, remove scratch roots
scratch.cleanup: remove each case scratch root on success, failure, timeout, cancellation, or source mismatch

logging.pipe: stdout and stderr are drained continuously
logging.backpressure: child cannot block on an undrained pipe; only a bounded tail is persisted

manufactured_cli_tests: unknown producer SHA rejection before child
child timeout process-group reap and cleanup
